title: American Mahjong Course · durable Scruffy audit

outcome.label: Sound with material gaps
outcome.summary: The course is distinctive and usable, not generic visual slop. Material gaps remain in route addressability, contents scalability, semantic page changes, contrast, and implementation shape. All seventeen records from the prior dashboard are reconciled: none disappeared, five are now fixed, cleared, or merged, four need targeted verification, and two new enhancements plus three strengths were added.
outcome.confidence: high for registry continuity and sampled source, tasks, responsive behavior, and contrast; moderate for items explicitly marked needs-verification

product_frame.question: Who is it for?
product_frame.answer: An adult beginner learning American Mahjong, often before joining experienced players at a physical table.

product_frame.question: What job does it perform?
product_frame.answer: Teach rules and table procedure as a sequenced, resumable course.

product_frame.question: What is the primary action?
product_frame.answer: Read a lesson, operate its learning control, and advance.

product_frame.question: What is meaningfully different?
product_frame.answer: A self-contained, visually Mahjong-specific course with reveals, transcript, speech, progress, and print support.

product_frame.question: Why return?
product_frame.answer: Continue a thirty-two-page course across interrupted sittings and retrieve rules before play.

product_frame.question: What means success?
product_frame.answer: A learner can find and correctly apply a rule at the table.

tasks.evidence: Visible content and semantic state changed.

tasks.result: Content, fixed navigation, and sampled controls remained usable without obvious horizontal overflow.

capabilities.scope: Public 760-line, 86,582-character page and exact implementation counts.
Desktop plus 375 by 812; Contents, navigation, reveal, transcript, and audio sampled.
Native-control reachability and ArrowRight sampled; full focus-visible sequence not retained.
Prior annotated Contents, lesson, and quiz evidence retained; current mobile screenshots were not exported.
Sampled console and semantic inspection; no full assistive-technology run.
No Core Web Vitals, long-task, or full waterfall evidence.
Prior HTML supplied seventeen stable IDs; localStorage decision state was unavailable and the later six-item export reused IDs inconsistently, so no choice was invented.
Public test bed remained read-only; only audit artifacts and the skill were changed.

scores.evidence: Audience, sequence, primary action, and success signal are understandable.
Thirty-two states share one URL and Contents remains an inline strip.
Core controls and resume work; speech and focus feedback need targeted verification.
No semantic regions or lesson announcement; three measured normal-text contrast failures.
Distinctive subject-specific system with clear lesson hierarchy; two visual suspicions were cleared and two narrowed.
One file owns content, state, speech, rendering, and 256 inline styles.

work_orders.title: Extract content and state contracts
work_orders.summary: Separate lessons, route identity, platform capability adapters, semantic shell, and visual roles while preserving rendered behavior.
acceptance_checks: All thirty-two lessons render unchanged before targeted improvements.
Lesson data and route state are independently testable.
Existing reveal, transcript, resume, print, and mobile behavior remains green.
work_orders.verification: Source contract tests plus representative browser tasks

work_orders.title: Add addressable lesson navigation
work_orders.summary: Create stable lesson and module addresses, browser history, local-progress fallback, and an explicit return state.
acceptance_checks: Copied URLs open the exact lesson.
Returning learners can resume or start over.
work_orders.verification: Fresh-session link, history, and reload tests

work_orders.title: Replace inline Contents with semantic navigation
work_orders.summary: Use a focus-managed disclosure or drawer with current module state and scalable mobile behavior.
acceptance_checks: Open and close focus behavior is deterministic.
Twenty modules remain usable at 320 pixels.
Progress overview does not duplicate navigation.
work_orders.verification: Keyboard, pointer, screen-width, and accessibility-tree checks

work_orders.title: Establish semantic page-change behavior
work_orders.summary: Add intentional landmarks, lesson heading behavior, announcement or focus placement, and focus-visible regression coverage.
acceptance_checks: Semantic regions appear in the accessibility tree.
Each lesson change is announced once.
All representative tasks are keyboard operable with visible focus.
work_orders.verification: Accessibility tree, keyboard walkthrough, and one screen-reader pass

work_orders.title: Correct accessible color roles
work_orders.summary: Create role-specific text colors without discarding the existing palette.
acceptance_checks: Every normal text/control pairing is at least 4.5 to 1.

work_orders.title: Make speech capability explicit
work_orders.summary: Represent supported, playing, stopped, unavailable, and error speech states.
acceptance_checks: Supported and unsupported environments both produce truthful feedback.
Completion and cancellation restore idle state.
work_orders.verification: Confirmed Web Speech environment plus unsupported-capability simulation

work_orders.title: Add durable regression coverage
work_orders.summary: Automate the core contracts and benchmark unmatched-term retrieval before committing to search.
acceptance_checks: Routes, persistence fallback, semantic regions, contrast, mobile Contents, reveal, and transcript are covered.
Search is prioritized only if the unmatched-term benchmark proves value.
work_orders.verification: Framework-agnostic browser suite at desktop and 375 pixels
